'''Vorkutangrad''' is a mapped polity in the central-eastern region of Avant, shown on both the 2003 and 2022 map references.

Old ideology source material uses the name Vorkuta for the industrial metropolis where [[Gorodovaya Syndikalizm]] emerged. This draft treats Vorkuta as a short or older form connected to map-facing Vorkutangrad until the user confirms the exact naming relationship.

== Industrial Role ==

Vorkutangrad is source-attested as an industrial metropolis with major factories, residential-industrial districts, worker assemblies, and a distinctive urban syndicalist tradition.

Its main 1994-back importance is ideological. The [[Vorkutan Labor Crisis]] and [[Vorkutan Great Reorganization]] made it a model for integrated worker control of production, infrastructure, and city government.
